title: settling-frobenius-structure
description: The canonical commutative Frobenius algebra (Z, eta, mu, epsilon, Delta) carried by the cohomology Z(B)=H*(F_vB) of a boundary predication system, with unit/multiplication/counit/comultiplication induced by the special settling cobordisms (disk, pair-of-pants, and their Verdier duals); it is the algebraic projection of the corpus's settling TQFT, refined into a K_4-hat-graded structure by the gauge sector.

carrier.description: the underlying Z-module: the cohomology of the settling-associated sheaf at the boundary valuation v_B

unit.description: induced by the disk cobordism D : empty -> B; eta(1) is the H^0 class of the all-bottom initial state evolved to v_B

multiplication.description: induced by the pair-of-pants cobordism P; the cohomology class of the joint settling of the two inputs on the merged cell-system

counit.description: induced by the dual disk D^vee (Verdier-dual settling); the trace pairing integrating a class over B to a single integer

comultiplication.description: induced by the dual pair-of-pants P^vee; the Verdier-adjoint of mu relative to the trace pairing, splitting one boundary into two

frobeniusCompatibility.description: (id tensor mu) o (Delta tensor id) = Delta o mu = (mu tensor id) o (id tensor Delta), the topological manifestation of gluing the pair-of-pants to its dual

commutative.description: mu o sigma = mu, from the swap symmetry P o sigma = P of the pair-of-pants in its two input boundaries

gaugeGraded.description: K_4-hat-graded: Z(B) splits into four isotypic sectors and mu(Z^chi1 tensor Z^chi2) subseteq Z^{chi1 . chi2}, refining the classical Frobenius structure by gauge sector
